evals.prompt: Create a skill for converting messy clinic CSV exports into a cleaned Excel workbook with one summary sheet and one validation sheet.
evals.expected_output: A lean skill with scripts for deterministic CSV/XLSX handling, realistic evals, validation guidance, and packaging steps.

assertions.text: The draft separates deterministic transformation code into scripts rather than prose-only instructions.
The draft includes at least two realistic eval prompts or an evals.json scaffold.
The SKILL.md frontmatter description includes trigger contexts, not only a title.

evals.prompt: This existing PDF skill keeps over-triggering for generic article summaries. Improve it without changing the name.
evals.expected_output: An update plan that snapshots the original skill, preserves the name, adjusts the trigger description, and tests near-miss negatives.

assertions.text: The response preserves the original name unless the user requests a rename.
The response uses the old version as a baseline.
The response proposes should-not-trigger near-miss tests.
